summary: CHA-0001 remedy, criterion 18: Studio/sim/MergeSurvivor.Sim run at seed 12345 against the pre-remedy tree (commit f00be6e, before WaveScheduler.Tick's non-progress check) and the post-remedy working tree. Studio/evidence/sims/metrics_pre.json and metrics_post.json are byte-identical (diff exit code 0) -- no metric moved. Program.cs's RunSchedule calls Tick only with dt in {1/30, 1/60, 1/240}, orders of magnitude away from both the absorption region (~1e8 for interval=2f) and the round-half-to-even counterexample found during this task (~3.36e7 for interval=2f), so this confirms the remedy's practical effect on this harness's current configuration but does not, by itself, confirm RUL-0003's general monotonicity argument, which this task found to be false in general (see final report / escalation).
